description: DB-VITALS (docs/operations/aws-revisao-arquitetura.md, finding 10): the allocated disk of the engine's database, in bytes (the RDS instance has 20 GiB; Postgres cannot read it). The live service divides the database's size by it (platform.db.vitals disk_ratio) to say how full the disk is; a change of the instance's storage is followed by PUT /v1/config/service.db_disk_bytes.
